# Programs One summer program. UTA, the partner agency, runs its own separate internship program


*Last updated: November 2026*


No Klutch Sports Group internship is open as of November 2026. KLUTCH runs one paid program, the KLUTCH Summer Internship, and posts it on the job board of its partner agency UTA. The 2026 posting went up on January 12, 2026, closed on February 13, 2026, and started interns on June 2, 2026, per KLUTCH's own posting. The summer 2027 posting is expected around mid-January 2027, with a deadline around mid-February 2027, projected from the 2026 posting. Here's the cycle in plain words: you apply this winter, you intern in summer 2027.

## What Is a Klutch Sports Group Internship?


A Klutch Sports Group internship is the KLUTCH Summer Internship, a paid 10-week program for undergraduates in the sports business, based in Los Angeles or New York City. KLUTCH was founded in 2012 by CEO Rich Paul and describes itself as Black-owned and women-led. It represents athletes, coaches and executives across the NBA, WNBA, NFL, MLB and global football, and also works on athlete marketing and brand partnerships. KLUTCH launched its partnership with UTA (United Talent Agency) in 2019, and UTA's postings list KLUTCH as an affiliated company, which is why the internship appears on UTA's job board. TIME named KLUTCH to its first TIME100 Most Influential Companies list in 2021, and GQ named it one of its 20 Most Creative Companies in 2024.


## When Do Klutch Sports Group Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


KLUTCH runs one summer intake. For 2026, its posting on UTA's job board carries a publish date of January 12, 2026, an application deadline of February 13, 2026, and a program start of June 2, 2026, for 10 weeks. That's about a month to apply and about four and a half months from posting to start. Applications for summer 2027 are expected to open around mid-January 2027 and close around mid-February 2027. Treat those as projections from one cycle: social posts suggest the 2024 posting went up later in the spring, so the date has moved before.

### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


Last cycle had one hard deadline, not a rolling window. The 2026 posting gave students from January 12 to February 13, 2026, about a month, and it said so plainly: "Application Deadline: February 13, 2026." The posting also required a cover letter answering one of three questions, which takes longer to do well than a résumé upload. Have that letter drafted before the summer 2027 posting appears, then apply in its first week.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Here's what the 2026 KLUTCH posting asked for. Check the summer 2027 posting, since terms can change:


• **Class year:** undergraduate students. The posting didn't name a class year.


• **GPA:** not published.


• **Work authorization and sponsorship:** not published.


• **Location:** on site in Los Angeles or New York City. Plan for housing in the city you choose.


• **Application:** a résumé plus a required cover letter answering one of three questions.


### Is the GPA a Hard Cutoff?


There's no GPA figure in KLUTCH's posting, so there's no published cutoff. The posting's own list stresses passion for sports and entertainment, interpersonal skills, reliability, communication, adaptability and attention to detail. Your cover letter is where those show, so spend more time on it than on your GPA line.

## What Skills Does Klutch Sports Group Look For, and How Do You Build Them?


Only one KLUTCH intern job description exists, the 2026 posting, so read it as one employer's wording rather than a pattern. **Business skills:** the program covers "client representation, strategic communication, marketing, and partnership development." **People skills:** it asks for strong interpersonal skills, being "personable, service-minded", and outstanding communication, "both verbally and in writing". **Work habits:** reliability and good judgment, adaptability in fast-paced environments, and attention to detail with tight deadlines.

## What Is the Klutch Sports Group Application and Interview Process Like?


KLUTCH doesn't publish its interview stages. This is what the 2026 posting asked for, plus what to set up now:


1. **Bookmark the board now.** KLUTCH posts on[UTA's job board](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/united-talent-agency) . Look for a title starting with the year and "KLUTCH Summer Internship".


2. **Draft your cover letter.** In 2026 it had to answer one of three questions: why a career in sports interests you, what you hope to get out of the internship, or which accomplishment you're most proud of and why.


3. **Pick an office.** The 2026 program offered Los Angeles and New York City.


4. **Apply before the deadline.** The 2026 deadline was February 13, 2026, about a month after the posting went up.


5. **Interviews and offer.** Not published. Watch your email after the deadline.


These steps come from one cycle. Go by the summer 2027 posting when it appears.


### What Students on Reddit Say


We searched Reddit for first-hand accounts of the KLUTCH Summer Internship and found only general threads about sports agents, none from interns, so there are no community cards here.


## How Do You Stand Out for a Klutch Sports Group Internship?


Three moves. First, be ready before the posting appears. Last cycle's window was about a month, so have your résumé and cover letter done by early January. Second, make the cover letter specific. Pick one of the three questions and answer it with something you did, not general enthusiasm for sports; KLUTCH's posting lists communication and attention to detail among the things it looks for, and the letter is your writing sample. Third, show sports business work, not only fandom: an athlete brand analysis, a partnership pitch or a social campaign. KLUTCH doesn't publish class size or how many interns get return offers.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 Klutch Sports Group internship?


No. The 2026 KLUTCH Summer Internship closed on February 13, 2026, and started on June 2, 2026, per KLUTCH's posting. As of November 2026 no KLUTCH internship is open. The summer 2027 posting is expected around mid-January 2027, with a deadline around mid-February 2027, projected from the 2026 posting.


### When will the summer 2027 KLUTCH internship open?


It hasn't been announced. The 2026 posting went up on January 12, 2026, so the summer 2027 posting is expected around mid-January 2027, with a deadline around mid-February 2027. That's a projection from one cycle, so check UTA's job board weekly from early January rather than waiting for a set date.


### How much do Klutch Sports Group interns make?


The 2026 KLUTCH Summer Internship paid $18.50 an hour, per KLUTCH's posting on UTA's job board. That's the official rate for the 10-week program in both Los Angeles and New York City. The 2027 rate isn't posted yet, so read the pay line on the summer 2027 posting when it appears.


### Where do KLUTCH interns work?


In Los Angeles or New York City, per the 2026 posting, which listed the role as on site. KLUTCH also has offices in Atlanta, Nashville, Phoenix, London and Munich, but the 2026 internship named only Los Angeles and New York. Plan for summer housing in whichever city you choose.


### Who can apply for a Klutch Sports Group internship?


Undergraduate students, per the 2026 posting, which described the program as being for high-potential undergraduates. It didn't state a GPA, class year, major or work-authorization rule. Read the qualifications on the summer 2027 posting when it appears, since KLUTCH can change them between cycles.


### Is the KLUTCH internship the same as UTA's internship?


No. KLUTCH posts its own KLUTCH Summer Internship on UTA's job board because the two are partners, but UTA also runs its own separate internship program across the agency. They have different titles and calendars. For a KLUTCH role, look for a posting with KLUTCH in the title.


No KLUTCH internship is open today, and the summer 2027 posting is expected around mid-January 2027. Get your cover letter ready now, and if you want a finished project to talk about, a[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) takes about 5 to 10 hours a week.
